achievement.monoculture.nextStep: Choose a cheap multi-harvest crop such as Blueberry or Cranberry and ship it through the Shipping Bin; direct shop sales do not count. All units must be the same valid crop.
achievement.millionaire.nextStep: There is no deadline. Reaching 1,000,000g before Grandpa's first visit grants all seven evaluation earnings points, but the achievement unlocks at any time.
achievement.local-legend.nextStep: Complete every Community Center bundle and attend the ceremony. Buying a Joja membership closes this route; the Joja achievement requires another save.
achievement.blue-ribbon.nextStep: Bring nine items covering six different categories when possible. Quality and value help, but variety matters: use animal products, artisan goods, cooking, fish, forage, fruit, minerals, and vegetables. Retrieve the items after judging.
achievement.distant-shore.nextStep: Finish the Community Center or Joja route, then repair Willy's boat with 200 Hardwood, 5 Iridium Bars, and 5 Battery Packs. Buy a ticket and travel to Ginger Island.
achievement.soup.nextStep: For Year 1, save a gold-quality Cauliflower from spring or use a suitable gold-quality fish such as Sturgeon or Catfish. Several valuable gold or iridium crops and animal products also work. Bring the item to the Luau, add it to the soup, and speak with Lewis.
achievement.two-thumbs.nextStep: Unlock the Movie Theater after completing the Community Center and Missing Bundle, or by buying Joja's final upgrade. Buy a ticket, optionally invite someone, and watch the full movie.
achievement.infinite-power.nextStep: Obtain a Galaxy Sword, Hammer, or Dagger. At the Volcano Forge, combine it with three Galaxy Souls, one per operation; each forge also consumes Cinder Shards.
achievement.full-house.nextStep: Upgrade the farmhouse twice to obtain the nursery, get married, and maintain a strong relationship with your spouse. Accept the child question twice and wait for each child.
achievement.complete-collection.nextStep: Donate all 53 minerals and 42 artifacts. Use the missing museum groups to decide which geodes, fishing chests, Artifact Spots, and areas can still produce a new piece.
achievement.joja.nextStep: Buy a Joja membership for 5,000g and pay for every community development project. This removes Community Center bundles; Local Legend requires another save.
achievement.danger-deep.nextStep: Unlock Qi's Walnut Room on Ginger Island and accept Danger in the Deep. Descend from floor 1 to 120 within the time limit.
achievement.master-angler.nextStep: Personally catch every required collection species, including legendary, Crab Pot, and Ginger Island fish. Purchased fish do not count; Qi's Extended Family fish are not required.
achievement.stardrops.nextStep: The seven sources are the Fair, floor 100 of The Mines, a spouse or roommate at 12.5 hearts, Old Master Cannoli, Willy's letter after Master Angler, the museum, and Krobus's shop.
achievement.protector.nextStep: Complete every category on the Monster Eradication Goals board in the Adventurer's Guild and collect Gil's rewards.
achievement.neighbors.nextStep: After repairing the large tree in Cindersap Forest, complete the raccoon couple's requests. Wait seven days between requests and continue until the family has eight children, then revisit the forest.
achievement.full-shipment.nextStep: Open Collections > Items Shipped and fill every silhouette by shipping at least one unit through the Shipping Bin. Direct shop sales do not count.
achievement.polyculture.nextStep: Ship 15 of each of the 28 required crops through the Shipping Bin. Coffee Bean counts; flowers, Ancient Fruit, wild berries, and unrelated crops do not replace a requirement.
achievement.well-read.nextStep: Only books that grant permanent powers count. Check Special Items & Powers and seek missing books through the Bookseller, boxes, fishing, mining, prizes, and special vendors.
achievement.gourmet.nextStep: Cook every recipe at least once in the farmhouse kitchen or with a Cookout Kit. Follow The Queen of Sauce, raise friendships, buy shop recipes, and then gather the ingredients.
achievement.craft-master.nextStep: Enable advanced crafting information to see how many times each recipe was crafted. Learn every recipe, then craft each at least once.
achievement.perfection.nextStep: Use the Perfection Tracker in Qi's Walnut Room. Reach 100% across shipping, buildings, friendships, skills, Stardrops, recipes, fish, and Golden Walnuts, then enter the Summit.
achievement.prairie-king.nextStep: Play Journey of the Prairie King in the Stardrop Saloon and defeat the final boss. Prioritize fire rate and damage upgrades and save power-ups for difficult areas.
achievement.fector.nextStep: Complete Journey of the Prairie King without losing a life. You can leave after a stage and continue from the minigame save another day; restart before finishing if you die.

today.luck.excellent.label: The spirits are very happy: excellent luck.
today.luck.excellent.advice: A great day to seek depth, treasure, and rare resources
today.luck.excellent.recommendation1: Ideal for descending many floors in The Mines or Skull Cavern: ladders and treasure rooms appear more easily.
today.luck.excellent.recommendation2: A good opportunity to fish for treasure chests, break rocks for geodes and coal, or use the Copper Pan.
today.luck.favorable.label: The spirits are in good humor: favorable luck.
today.luck.favorable.advice: Use the good luck in the mines or while fishing for chests
today.luck.favorable.recommendation1: Prioritize mining, fishing for chests, or panning if they were already in your plans.
today.luck.favorable.recommendation2: It also slightly improves wood drops while chopping and a few uncommon rewards.
today.luck.veryBad.label: The spirits are very displeased: very bad luck.
today.luck.veryBad.advice: Avoid a major expedition and focus on reliable tasks
today.luck.veryBad.recommendation1: A good day to water, plant, organize chests, talk to villagers, build, or complete requests: those tasks barely depend on luck.
today.luck.veryBad.recommendation2: If you enter the mines, expect more rocks per ladder and bring food; opening geodes today does not worsen their contents.
today.luck.unfavorable.label: The spirits are displeased: unfavorable luck.
today.luck.unfavorable.advice: Farm work is more worthwhile than testing your luck today
today.luck.unfavorable.recommendation1: Leave Skull Cavern or an ambitious expedition for another day unless it is urgent.
today.luck.unfavorable.recommendation2: Use the day for farm work, socializing, processing items, or opening geodes: their contents do not depend on daily luck.
today.luck.neutral.label: The spirits are neutral: normal luck.
today.luck.neutral.advice: A neutral day: follow your plans without changing priorities
today.luck.neutral.recommendation1: There is no need to change your plans; any activity is reasonable.
today.luck.neutral.recommendation2: Luck affects mines, fishing chests, panning, garbage cans, and some drops, but not normal crop quality or geode contents.
today.luck.explanation: Daily luck ranges from −0.100 to +0.100 and is not a direct percentage. It mainly affects ladders and resources from rocks, Skull Cavern treasure rooms, fishing chests, panning, garbage cans, and some drops. It does not change predetermined geode contents or normal crop quality.

quest.tip.coop1: Visit Robin's Carpenter's Shop in the Mountain and choose Construct Farm Buildings.
quest.tip.coop2: A Coop costs 4,000g, 300 Wood, and 100 Stone. Clear a 6×3 footprint before ordering it.
quest.tip.coop3: Construction takes three days; Robin starts working the morning after you order it.
quest.tip.mine1: You have reached mine level {level}; the objective completes at level 120.
quest.tip.mine2: Use the elevator every five floors so progress is permanent. Start early and prioritize ladders over clearing each floor.
quest.tip.mine3: Bring food without combat buffs for energy, plus separate buff food if available. A good-luck day improves ladder chances.
quest.tip.building: Visit Robin in the Mountain with the required money and materials, then choose Construct Farm Buildings.
quest.tip.delivery: Carry the requested item and speak directly to the requester. Giving it through the normal gift action completes the delivery.
quest.tip.collection: Gather the items after accepting the quest; existing chest stock does not advance the counter. Keep the collected items until you read the final objective.
quest.tip.fishing: Only fish caught after accepting the quest count. Match the fish's season, weather, location, and time window.
quest.tip.monsters: Use the mine floors where that monster commonly appears, then check whether the final step asks you to report back to someone.
quest.tip.socialize: Speak to every required villager once. Festival conversations may not count, so use ordinary town visits.
quest.tip.generic: Follow the current objective shown above. The journal updates automatically when the next step becomes available.

growth.point.earningsHow: This counts all gold earned during the game, even after spending it. Sell crops, fish, minerals, or processed goods; it does not need to remain in your balance.
growth.point.skillRemaining: {count} levels remaining across Farming, Mining, Foraging, Fishing, and Combat
growth.point.skillsHow: Level the skills that are already closest to their next level; all five count equally toward this total.
growth.point.petHow: Pet it every day and keep its water bowl filled. This is slow but reliable progress that costs no gold.
growth.point.skullHow: Reach floor 120 of The Mines. On good-luck days, bring food and craft staircases if a floor stalls your progress.
growth.milestone.museum.label: Museum collection
growth.milestone.museum.how: Complete Gunther's collection by donating all 53 minerals and 42 different artifacts.
growth.milestone.angler.label: Every fish
growth.milestone.angler.how: Personally catch every species required for Master Angler. Buying or receiving a fish does not count.
growth.milestone.shipment.label: Full shipment
growth.milestone.shipment.how: Ship at least one of every item on the Items Shipped tab through the Shipping Bin; direct shop sales do not count.
growth.milestone.marriage.label: Marriage and two farmhouse upgrades
growth.milestone.marriage.how: Get married and buy Robin's first two farmhouse upgrades, through the nursery upgrade.
growth.milestone.friends5.label: 5 friends at eight hearts
growth.milestone.friends5.how: Reach eight hearts with five villagers. Talking, giving liked gifts, and remembering birthdays speeds progress.
growth.milestone.friends10.label: 10 friends at eight hearts
growth.milestone.friends10.how: Reach eight hearts with ten villagers. This point is added to the point for the first five friends.
growth.milestone.pet.label: Maximum pet friendship
growth.milestone.pet.how: Pet your animal every day and fill its water bowl. The point is awarded at maximum friendship.
growth.milestone.community.label: Community Center and ceremony
growth.milestone.community.how: Complete every Community Center bundle and attend the ceremony. The Joja route replaces this objective.
growth.milestone.skull.label: Skull Key
growth.milestone.skull.how: Reach floor 120 of The Mines to find the Skull Key, which opens Skull Cavern in the Desert.
growth.milestone.rusty.label: Rusty Key
growth.milestone.rusty.how: Donate 60 different items to the museum. Gunther gives you the Rusty Key, which opens the Sewers.

planner.catalogRequiredDetail: Restart Companion to extract crop, fruit-tree, price, and season rules from your local game installation. SMAPI is not required, and Companion will not guess or download a substitute catalog.
planner.chooseProducer: Choose a crop or fruit tree

planner.compare.detail: The table shows exact values; the chart makes the expected net-profit difference easier to see.
planner.applied.title: Configuration applied to this result
planner.applied.forcePlantToday: Plant today even out of season
planner.replant: Buy and replant after each harvest
planner.forcePlantTodayDetail: Include the purchase even if the crop cannot grow today.
planner.assumptions: The period starts today. Outdoor crops wait for their first valid planting date unless planting today is forced. Crops are watered every day and sold raw. Farming level changes variable harvests and fertilizer quality; Tiller changes sale value; Agriculturist and growth accelerators change initial growth time. Replanting costs are deducted from profit.
planner.warning.end-before-start: The end date is before the start date.
planner.warning.end-date-overrides-durat: The exact end date takes precedence over the duration.
planner.warning.unverified-producer-data: Some local rules could not be verified, so this result should not be treated as exact.
planner.warning.missing-startup-cost: No verified purchase price is available for this producer.
planner.warning.missing-output-value: No verified sale value is available for its output.
planner.warning.cannot-plant-on-start-da: The seeds are included as a cost, but this crop cannot be planted outdoors on the start date and therefore produces no income. Its growing season is: {seasons}. Choose a valid season, the greenhouse, or Ginger Island.
planner.warning.no-planting-date-in-hori: This crop cannot be planted during the selected period. Its growing season is: {seasons}. No seeds or fertilizer have been purchased.
planner.warning.planting-delayed: The period starts today, but planting waits until the first valid date: {date}.
planner.warning.no-production-in-horizon: This producer will not yield anything during the selected period and location.
planner.warning.target-not-profitable: The requested profit cannot be reached with these assumptions.
planner.warning.fertilizer-cost-unknown: {fertilizer} affects the result, but its cost is not included because the local game catalog has no verified gold purchase price for it.
